name: Lena Düpont - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point 1; Directive (UE) 2015/637 – Article 7 – après le paragraphe 4  - Am 39
title: REPORT on the draft for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2015/637 on the coordination and cooperation measures to facilitate consular protection for unrepresented citizens of the Union in third countries and Directive (EU) 2019/997 establishing an EU Emergency Travel Document
part_text: Amendment 4a. When providing consular protection to unrepresented citizens, Member States shall take into account an intersectional approach to the specific needs of vulnerable groups, including victims of forced marriage and marital captivity, and individuals at risk of discrimination on any ground such as those referred to in Article 21 of the Charter and in case-law.
